name: Typescript Runtime Safety
description: Guides runtime type validation in TypeScript with Zod: schema design, branded types, type guards, runtime validation at application boundaries, and parse-not-validate patterns. Use when the user asks about Zod schemas, runtime validation, branded types, type guards, parse-not-validate, API boundary validation. Do NOT use when the user asks about TypeScript type system features (use `typescript-type-patterns`), project setup (use `typescript-project-setup`), testing (use `javascript-testing-patterns`).
